title: Correlates of MAPK/Nrf2/STAT-3 Pathway Protein Expression With Morin Treatment in Helicobacter pylori-Infected Gastric Epithelial Cells-1 Cells: An Exploratory In Vitro Study.
journal: Journal of biochemical and molecular toxicology
one_liner_zh: 该研究为体外细胞实验，探讨莫林对幽门螺杆菌感染胃上皮细胞中MAPK/Nrf2/STAT-3通路蛋白表达的影响，仅涉及信号通路蛋白表达与分子对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Helicobacter pylori infection is a major risk factor for gastric cancer (GC), but the molecular mechanisms remain incompletely understood. This exploratory in vitro study investigated whether treatment with the flavonoid morin correlates with altered expression of MAPK/Nrf2/STAT-3 pathway proteins in H. pylori-infected human gastric epithelial cells (GES-1). GES-1 cells were infected with H. pylori (ATCC 49503, MOI 100:1) and treated with 40 microM morin for 24 h. Outcomes included cell viability (MTT assay), ROS production (DCFH-DA), oxidative DNA damage (comet assay), glutathione and malondialdehyde levels (biochemical assays), protein expression (Western blot), and gene expression (RT-PCR). Molecular docking predicted binding affinity between morin and pathway proteins. This study used n = 3 biological replicates per group and a lenient false discovery rate threshold (Q = 0.25) appropriate for hypothesis generation; findings require independent replication. In this exploratory study, morin treatment (40 microM) was associated with: Higher MTT-detectable viability in H. pylori-infected cultures compared to infected untreated controls (85% vs. 45%; q = 0.042) Lower intracellular ROS levels (q = 0.021) and reduced oxidative DNA damage (q = 0.018) compared to infected untreated controls Higher GSH and lower MDA levels compared to infected untreated controls Lower phosphorylation levels of MAPK family members (ERK, JNK, p38), PI3K/AKT, and STAT3/EGFR proteins compared to infected untreated controls Higher total Nrf2 protein expression and upregulation of HMOX1 and NQO1 mRNA compared to infected untreated controls Molecular docking predicted binding between morin and MAPK, STAT3, and NRF2 pathway proteins, but these computational findings require experimental validation. These correlative findings are consistent with the hypothesis that morin treatment engages MAPK/Nrf2/STAT-3 pathways in H. pylori-infected GES-1 cells. However, this study does not establish causality, Nrf2 activation (nuclear translocation not demonstrated), or therapeutic efficacy (no positive controls). The observed associations should be interpreted as hypothesis-generating and require independent replication, mechanistic validation (including Nrf2 loss-of-function experiments), and comparative studies with standard agents before any translational inference. Under the specific in vitro conditions tested (GES-1 cells, H. pylori ATCC 49503, 40 microM morin, 24-h exposure, n = 3 biological replicates), morin treatment was associated with lower ROS levels, reduced MAPK/STAT3 phosphorylation, and higher Nrf2 protein expression compared to infected untreated controls. These correlative findings are hypothesis-generating and do not establish therapeutic potential, safety, efficacy, or clinical relevance. Independent replication, comprehensive toxicological characterization (including normal cell lines and in vivo models), direct comparison with standard agents (clarithromycin, sulforaphane), and mechanistic validation (including Nrf2 loss-of-function experiments) are required before any consideration of morin for further development. This study provides no evidence to support morin as a therapeutic, adjuvant, or alternative agent.
abstract_zh: 幽门螺杆菌（Helicobacter pylori）感染是胃癌（gastric cancer, GC）的主要风险因素，但其分子机制尚未完全阐明。这项探索性体外研究考察了黄酮类化合物桑色素（morin）处理是否与H. pylori感染的人胃上皮细胞（GES-1）中MAPK/Nrf2/STAT-3通路蛋白表达的改变相关。GES-1细胞感染H. pylori（ATCC 49503，MOI 100:1），并用40微摩尔桑色素处理24小时。检测指标包括细胞活力（MTT法）、活性氧（ROS）产生（DCFH-DA）、氧化性DNA损伤（彗星实验）、谷胱甘肽和丙二醛水平（生化检测）、蛋白表达（Western blot）及基因表达（RT-PCR）。分子对接预测了桑色素与通路蛋白之间的结合亲和力。本研究每组使用n = 3个生物学重复，并采用适合假设生成的宽松错误发现率阈值（Q = 0.25）；研究结果需独立重复验证。在这项探索性研究中，桑色素处理（40微摩尔）与以下结果相关：与感染未处理对照组相比，H. pylori感染培养物中MTT可检测的细胞活力更高（85% vs. 45%；q = 0.042）；与感染未处理对照组相比，细胞内ROS水平更低（q = 0.021）且氧化性DNA损伤减少（q = 0.018）；与感染未处理对照组相比，GSH水平更高且MDA水平更低；与感染未处理对照组相比，MAPK家族成员（ERK、JNK、p38）、PI3K/AKT及STAT3/EGFR蛋白的磷酸化水平更低；与感染未处理对照组相比，总Nrf2蛋白表达更高，且HMOX1和NQO1 mRNA上调。分子对接预测了桑色素与MAPK、STAT3和NRF2通路蛋白之间的结合，但这些计算发现需实验验证。这些相关性发现与桑色素处理参与H. pylori感染的GES-1细胞中MAPK/Nrf2/STAT-3通路的假设一致。然而，本研究未建立因果关系、Nrf2激活（未证明核转位）或治疗有效性（无阳性对照）。观察到的关联应视为假设生成性的，需独立重复、机制验证（包括Nrf2功能缺失实验）以及与标准药物的比较研究，方可进行任何转化推断。在测试的特定体外条件下（GES-1细胞、H. pylori ATCC 49503、40微摩尔桑色素、24小时暴露、n = 3个生物学重复），与感染未处理对照组相比，桑色素处理与较低的ROS水平、降低的MAPK/STAT3磷酸化及更高的Nrf2蛋白表达相关。这些相关性发现是假设生成性的，不确立治疗潜力、安全性、有效性或临床相关性。在考虑桑色素进一步开发之前，需进行独立重复、全面的毒理学表征（包括正常细胞系和体内模型）、与标准药物（克拉霉素、萝卜硫素）的直接比较以及机制验证（包括Nrf2功能缺失实验）。本研究未提供任何证据支持桑色素作为治疗剂、辅助剂或替代药物。
